ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 'Operation Dream Job' — ISO/IMG-mounted lure binary side-loads attacker DLL
ucs.description: Hunts Labyrinth Chollima's signature recruitment-lure chain: target double-clicks an ISO/IMG (delivered via LinkedIn/WhatsApp) which mounts to a non-system drive letter, explorer.exe spawns a trojanized signed binary (PuTTY, AmazonVNC, TightVNC, SumatraPDF, FoxitReader, WireGuard) from that mount, and the binary side-loads a non-Microsoft DLL from the same directory — the exact tradecraft tied to Lazarus / ZINC / Diamond Sleet 'Dream Job' intrusions documented by Mandiant, ESET, and Microsoft (MSTIC) against aerospace, defense, and crypto employees.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, values(Processes.process) as cmdline, values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("putty.exe","AmazonVNC.exe","AmazonVNCViewer.exe","TightVNC.exe","SumatraPDF.exe","FoxitReader.exe","wireguard.exe","3CXDesktopApp.exe","x_trader.exe","X_TRADER.exe") by host, Processes.user, Processes.process_name, Processes.process_path, Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process_path, "^[D-Z]:\\\\") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | table firstTime host user parent_process_name process_name process_path cmdline hash
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let LazarusLureBinaries = dynamic(["putty.exe","amazonvnc.exe","amazonvncviewer.exe","tightvnc.exe","sumatrapdf.exe","foxitreader.exe","wireguard.exe","3cxdesktopapp.exe","x_trader.exe"]);
let MountedSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"   // ISO/IMG mount or USB — not the system drive
    | where FileName in~ (LazarusLureBinaries)
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SpawnedFile=FileName, SpawnedPath=FolderPath, SpawnedSHA256=SHA256,
              SpawnedPid=ProcessId, SpawnedCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let SideLoadedDll = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"^[D-Z]:\\"   // DLL loaded from the same removable mount
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | project DllTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, LoaderPid=InitiatingProcessId,
              LoadedDll=FileName, LoadedDllPath=FolderPath, LoadedDllSHA256=SHA256;
MountedSpawn
| join kind=inner (SideLoadedDll) on DeviceId, $left.SpawnedPid == $right.LoaderPid
| where DllTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SpawnedPath, SpawnedFile, SpawnedSHA256,
          LoadedDll, LoadedDllPath, LoadedDllSHA256, SpawnedCmd
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith @"\explorer.exe"
| where NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\.*\\(putty|amazonvnc|amazonvncviewer|tightvnc|sumatrapdf|foxitreader|wireguard|3cxdesktopapp|x_trader)\.exe$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.EXE OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\\putty.exe OR *\\PuTTY.exe OR *\\AmazonVNC.exe OR *\\AmazonVNCViewer.exe OR *\\TightVNC.exe OR *\\tightvnc.exe OR *\\SumatraPDF.exe OR *\\sumatrapdf.exe OR *\\FoxitReader.exe OR *\\foxitreader.exe OR *\\wireguard.exe OR *\\WireGuard.exe OR *\\3CXDesktopApp.exe OR *\\3cxdesktopapp.exe OR *\\X_TRADER.exe OR *\\x_trader.exe) -@Image:(C\:\\* OR c\:\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/explorer\.exe/i ImageFileName=/^[D-Z]:\\\\.*\\\\(putty|amazonvnc(viewer)?|tightvnc|sumatrapdf|foxitreader|wireguard|3cxdesktopapp|x_trader)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count(as=spawns))

ucs.title: [LLM] Lazarus 3CX/X_TRADER-style dead-drop C2 — side-loaded DLL beacons to raw.githubusercontent.com
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation pattern from Lazarus's supply-chain operations (3CX March 2023, X_TRADER 2022): a non-browser business application loads ffmpeg.dll / d3dcompiler_47.dll from a non-Windows path (side-load), and the same process then retrieves staged encrypted C2 from dead-drop hosts (raw.githubusercontent.com IconStorages repo, pastebin, IPFS gateways). This dead-drop-resolver pattern is a Lazarus / Diamond Sleet / Labyrinth Chollima signature documented by Mandiant, Symantec, and Volexity.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, min(_time) as firstTime, values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest_host from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest IN ("raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","pastebin.com","paste.ee","ipfs.io","cloudflare-ipfs.com") AND NOT All_Traffic.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","msteams.exe","Teams.exe","slack.exe","Slack.exe","code.exe","Code.exe","git.exe","Git.exe","GitHubDesktop.exe") by host, All_Traffic.app, All_Traffic.user | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | table firstTime host user app dest_host count | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let StagingHosts = dynamic(["raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","pastebin.com","paste.ee","ipfs.io","cloudflare-ipfs.com"]);
let LazarusSideloadDlls = dynamic(["ffmpeg.dll","d3dcompiler_47.dll","msvcr100.dll","winsta.dll","libnghttp2.dll","version.dll"]);
let KnownBrowsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","msteams.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","code.exe","git.exe","githubdesktop.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let SuspectDllLoads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName in~ (LazarusSideloadDlls)
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft")
    | project DllTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              LoaderName=InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderPath=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              LoaderPid=InitiatingProcessId, LoadedDll=FileName, LoadedDllPath=FolderPath,
              LoadedDllSHA256=SHA256;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (StagingHosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownBrowsers)
| join kind=inner (SuspectDllLoads) on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.LoaderPid
| where Timestamp between (DllTime .. DllTime + 1h)
| project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceName, LoaderName, LoaderPath,
          LoadedDll, LoadedDllPath, LoadedDllSHA256,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by NetTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let StagingHosts = dynamic(["raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","pastebin.com","paste.ee","ipfs.io","cloudflare-ipfs.com"]);
let KnownBrowsers = dynamic([@"\chrome.exe",@"\msedge.exe",@"\firefox.exe",@"\brave.exe",@"\opera.exe",@"\iexplore.exe",@"\teams.exe",@"\slack.exe",@"\code.exe",@"\git.exe",@"\curl.exe",@"\wget.exe"]);
let DnsHits = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where Name in~ (StagingHosts)
    | project DnsTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, ResolvedHost=Name;
let ProcCreate = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where not(NewProcessName has_any (KnownBrowsers))
    | where NewProcessName !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, Account;
DnsHits
| join kind=inner (ProcCreate) on Computer
| where DnsTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 1h)
| project DnsTime, ProcTime, Computer, Account, ResolvedHost, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine
| order by DnsTime desc

#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(raw\.githubusercontent\.com|gist\.githubusercontent\.com|pastebin\.com|paste\.ee|ipfs\.io|cloudflare-ipfs\.com)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|teams|slack|code|git|githubdesktop|curl|wget)\.exe$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/^C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count(as=resolutions), limit=200)
| resolutions > 0
